title: Group log lines by level
hints: `line.partition(":")` splits at the **first** colon and gives back `(before, sep, after)`. `sep` is `""` when there was no colon.
A `defaultdict(list)` creates the empty list the first time you touch a key, so `groups[level].append(message)` just works.
For each line: `level, sep, message = line.partition(":")`, `if not sep: continue`, then `groups[level.strip().upper()].append(message.strip())`. Finish with `return dict(groups)`.
